plugin.name: GTA Liberty City Stories Widescreen Fix (PCSX2F)
main.improvedwidescreensupport.descripti: Correct camera FOV, HUD, frontend and screen geometry for the emulator aspect ratio.
main.enable60fps.description: Run the game at 60 FPS instead of 30 FPS.
main.unthrottleemuduringloading.descript: Temporarily remove the emulator frame limit during loading.
controls.pccontrolscheme.description: Use the PC control scheme; native controller input remains available when disabled.
controls.mousesensitivity.description: Mouse camera speed. 1.0 turns the camera 0.002 radians per pixel at the default zoom.
hud.hudscale.description: Scale the HUD around its screen anchors.
display.cutsceneborders.description: Black bars that keep cutscenes in their 16:9 cinematic frame: letterbox above and below on narrower screens, pillarbox at the sides on wider screens. The bars slide in and out.

MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu in the game (English only for now). Close and reopen Plugins after changing it.
fovfactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view on top of the widescreen correction. 1.0 is the original framing; higher is wider. Cutscenes are not changed.
hudaspect.description: Keeps the HUD inside a centered box of this aspect ratio (for example 16:9 on an ultrawide screen). Auto uses the whole screen.
